source: STEER Project (Save the Children, iDE Cambodia, and the Cambodian Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries) - "Guide on Banana Cultivation Techniques" (សៀវភៅណែនាំស្តីអំពី បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះដំណាំចេក), February 2020
text:
Regular weeding around the base of each banana plant is needed because weeds compete strongly for nutrients and water, especially while plants are young; the guide recommends keeping the area around the stem clear and mounding soil up around the base as plants grow. Dry mulch material (crop residue or dried leaves) spread around the base helps suppress weeds, conserve soil moisture, and moderate soil temperature.

Fertilizing is paired with mounding: organic matter and fertilizer are worked into the soil around the base at intervals through the growing cycle rather than as a single application, supporting the heavy nutrient demand of banana's rapid vegetative growth and large bunch production.
